verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show a live, first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai. It is auth-gated with spec-compliant OAuth discovery and advertises read/write/mcp scopes, so an agent channel exists on the vendor's own domain. However, no vendor docs describe its tools, and no OpenAPI spec was found, so end-to-end agent scheduling is unproven. The scheduling features in the docs (rescheduling, scheduling links) are documented only as automatic or UI-driven behaviour, not as API or MCP operations. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for checking availability, booking, rescheduling and cancelling meetings; public API or MCP documentation; hands-on corroboration of an agent completing these actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can check availability, book, reschedule, and cancel meetings end to end through the API or MCP — no dashboard needed

citations.quote: a live, auth-gated MCP endpoint on the vendor's own domain speaking the per-spec MCP OAuth flow
the server publishes its own OAuth discovery document with read/write/mcp scopes
